messages.text:
Sorry it arrived faulty. Let's get it sorted.

The only order I can find on this email was cancelled before it shipped, so the miner you received must be on a different order. What's the order number on it, and which model is it?

Also tell me what it's doing: won't power on, shows an error code, low hashrate, or something else? Once I have that I can start the fix right away.
